properties.name: SA139
properties.notes: The site was allocated for residential development in the 2007 SSAL policy AL1 and is within the built up area of Horsham town meaning it is considered suitable for development. An application for 37 dwellings (DC/17/1853) was submitted for this site in September 2017 but has yet to be determined. It should be noted that the application covers a larger area than the allocation as it also includes 15 Crawley Road
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
